title: Protect what you are building
intro: Spiritual reflection can support a business decision when it stays connected to numbers, people, and action.

sections.heading: Name the decision
sections.body: Be specific about what you need to choose.

sections.heading: Check the practical facts
sections.body: Insight should sit beside your budget, timeline, and responsibilities.

sections.heading: Choose the next move
sections.body: Leave with one action you can complete.
